checks: Closing an untouched stale editor never prompts or overwrites newer disk content
Explicit save refuses a newer disk version and preserves the exact local draft
Save a copy preserves both versions; reload requires a decision and resets the baseline
Save on close rechecks disk after the dialog and keeps conflicting edits open
Repeated Ctrl+S while saving serializes the latest buffer without losing intervening edits
Undoing back to the saved text removes the recovery draft
Two workspaces keep independent editor models and cannot overwrite each other with an older baseline
New file opens its editor immediately with inline naming; Escape keeps a usable untitled.md
Inline naming chooses unique defaults, rejects existing names, and commits a new name without a popup
Settings persists the default new-file extension and applies it to the next editor tab
